title: 139. Jump Game II

examples.explanation: Jump from index 0 to index 1, then to the last index.

hints: Treat all indices reachable with the current number of jumps as one breadth-first-search layer.
While scanning a layer, track the farthest index any position in that layer can reach.
When the scan reaches the current layer's end, take one jump and make the farthest reach the next layer's end.
